create_iSDFWindow: create an iSDFWindow instance with a trainer, optim_iter callback, and font_id for interactive 3D visualization
reconstruct_mesh_iSDFWindow: reconstruct a 3D mesh from the SDF using marching cubes on the zero level set via reconstruct_mesh
compute_sdf_slices_iSDFWindow: compute SDF slices and display a colorbar with SDF value range using compute_sdf_slices
compute_depth_pcd_iSDFWindow: compute a colored depth point cloud from backprojected depth images using compute_depth_pcd
update_render_iSDFWindow: update the 3D scene render with latest frames, mesh, point cloud, and camera frustums via update_render
